papers.title: Business model innovation pathways: Digital transformation after disruption at The New York Times and The Washington Post
papers.abstract: Digital technologies increasingly challenge firms by disrupting the complementary assets that support value capture—such as distribution and monetization channels. While the phenomenon of complementary-asset discontinuity has begun to attract scholarly attention, we still lack an understanding of the different business model innovation pathways incumbents can pursue in response, especially when adapting to specific types of discontinuous changes. We address these gaps through a comparative case study of The New York Times and The Washington Post, two direct competitors that faced similar disruptions yet pursued divergent business model innovation pathways.
papers.summary_ja: デジタル技術が補完的資産（配信・マネタイズ）を破壊する中、NYTとWashington Postが採用した異なるBMI経路を比較分析し、破壊の種類に応じた最適な対応戦略を類型化した実証研究。
papers.analysis_unit: New York Times と Washington Post の比較事例研究（2社）

papers.title: The 2026 Service Research Priorities: AI-Driven Discovery, Interdisciplinary Influence Dynamics, and the "Interactive Service Scholarship Incubator" for Personalized Priorities
papers.abstract: This article presents the 2026 Service Research Priorities (SRPs), developed via a hybrid AI–human agenda-setting approach. We construct large-scale concept networks from more than 10,500 service-related articles in core service journals and Financial Times (FT) 50 outlets, and apply machine-learning link prediction to identify high-probability, but underexplored, concept pairs. Fifteen forward-looking themes emerge that fall into four topical clusters: (a) Human–AI Agency, Interactions, and Service Personalization; (b) Interdisciplinary Influence Dynamics; (c) Sustainable Service and Social Value Co-creation; (d) Methodological Innovation in Service Research.
papers.summary_ja: 10,500本超のサービス論文を機械学習で分析し、2026年のサービス研究優先テーマ15を4クラスターで特定。Human-AI協働・価値共創・持続可能サービスが最重要テーマとして浮上した。
papers.analysis_unit: サービス関連論文10,500件超の概念ネットワーク分析（機械学習によるリンク予測）

papers.title: Twin transition in manufacturing firms: The role of supply chain orchestration and supply chain business model innovation
papers.abstract: Twin transition, the concurrent development of digitalization practices and circular practices, are believed to be the key to firm performance. However, empirical evidence is currently scarce regarding the effect of twin transition on firm performance and the complementary practices that enable and realize it. This study draws on a survey of 188 Swedish manufacturing firms and employs PLS structural equation modelling to test the hypothesis. The results indicate that firm performance can be improved through twin transition, but only when supply chain orchestration and supply chain business model innovation are in place as complementary practices.
papers.summary_ja: スウェーデン製造業188社でデジタル化×循環化のTwin Transitionを実証し、企業業績への効果はサプライチェーン・オーケストレーションとBMIが補完的実践として機能することが条件であると示した。
papers.analysis_unit: スウェーデンの製造業188社の質問票調査（PLS-SEM）

papers.title: How managerial reflection initiates demand-side business model innovation
papers.abstract: Purpose Changes in the business environment present opportunities and challenges for companies, requiring managerial attention and active sensemaking concerning demand-side factors. In such situations, it is often necessary to challenge existing beliefs and mental models within the organisation by examining how these changes may impact the company's business model. Aligned with the cognitive approach in business model innovation research, this paper aims to develop a conceptual framework explaining how managerial reflection on demand-side changes initiates business model innovation.
papers.summary_ja: 需要環境変化に対する経営者の「内省（reflection）」がBMIのトリガーとなるメカニズムを認知アプローチ・センスメイキング理論で概念化し、組織的BMI変革の新しい説明フレームを提示した。
papers.analysis_unit: 概念論文（需要サイドのビジネスモデルイノベーション枠組みの構築）

papers.title: The role of digital service innovation for value proposition co-creation in emerging sustainable platform ecosystems
papers.abstract: This study aims to explore how value propositions emerge during the early stages of sustainability-focused B2B digital platform ecosystems. It examines the role of Digital Service Innovation (DSI) in supporting collaborative practices that address regulatory uncertainty, infrastructural fragmentation, and environmental challenges. An exploratory single-case study was conducted, focusing on the development of a regional biogas platform ecosystem in Finland. Data were collected through 20 semi-structured interviews with key stakeholders.
papers.summary_ja: フィンランドのバイオガスB2Bプラットフォームを事例に、デジタルサービス・イノベーション（DSI）が持続可能なプラットフォーム生態系における価値提案の共創をいかに支援するかを探索的に明らかにした。
papers.analysis_unit: フィンランドの地域バイオガス・プラットフォームエコシステム1件の探索的単一事例研究（半構造化インタビュー20件）

papers.title: Ambidextrous leadership and product innovativeness in AI firms: the mediating role of knowledge-based dynamic capabilities and the moderating role of entrepreneurial orientation
papers.abstract: This study aims to examine how ambidextrous leadership influences product innovativeness by exploring the mediating role of knowledge-based dynamic capabilities and the moderating role of entrepreneurial orientation within firms. A quantitative research design was employed. Survey data were collected from 405 respondents representing 76 artificial intelligence firms located in the Yangtze River Delta region of China. The data were analyzed using covariance-based structural equation modeling with AMOS 26. The results indicated that ambidextrous leadership was significantly and positively related to product innovativeness through knowledge-based dynamic capabilities.
papers.summary_ja: 中国AI企業76社405名の実証研究で、両利きリーダーシップが知識ベース・ダイナミック・ケイパビリティを媒介して製品革新性を高め、起業家的志向がその効果を調整することを確認した。
papers.analysis_unit: 中国・長江デルタ地域のAI企業76社・回答者405名の質問票調査（共分散構造分析）

papers.title: The Designing Mind in the Age of AI : The material and the competency
papers.abstract: Most designers using generative AI today cannot fully explain the decisions embedded in the work they are shipping. That should concern us. Generative AI entering design workflows is reshaping how designers think, what problems they can see and which capacities they are losing the habit of using. This is urgent – but not new. Design thinkers have wrestled with these questions for decades, and their frameworks offer guidance for what to protect and how.
papers.summary_ja: 生成AIがデザインワークフローに浸透する中、デザイナーが「失いつつある認知能力」と「守るべき設計コンピテンシー」を批判的に論じた実務志向の概念論文。
papers.analysis_unit: エッセイ・概念論文（生成AI時代のデザイナーの思考と能力の考察）

papers.title: Who Could Possibly be Interested in Visiting Us? Circular Business Model Innovation in a Collaborative Rural Hub
papers.abstract: The shift towards remote and hybrid work enables people to pursue individual lifestyles, further away from their place of work. However, remote areas typically face challenges related to service provision and social activities. Using a qualitative case study approach, the paper investigates how circular business model innovation unfolds in a collaborative ecosystem of small enterprises located in rural Sweden: 'Climbers' Hub', comprising coworking, hotel, and climbing related services.
papers.summary_ja: スウェーデン過疎地の「Climbers' Hub」を事例に、複数SMEが協働するエコシステムで循環型BMIがいかに展開されるかを質的に分析し、地域協働と循環経済のシナジーを示した。
papers.analysis_unit: スウェーデン過疎地の協働ハブ1件の質的事例研究（インタビュー・観察・文書レビュー）

papers.title: From catch-up to creation: technological leapfrogging for business model innovation in SMEs
papers.abstract: Purpose This research aims to explore how resource-constrained small and medium-sized enterprises leverage technological leapfrogging as a means of innovating their business models. Design/methodology/approach A qualitative multiple-case study approach focused on SMEs in emerging knowledge hubs in China.
papers.summary_ja: 資源制約のある中国SMEが技術的リープフロッギング（段階を飛ばした技術転換）によってBMIを実現するプロセスを複数ケーススタディで探索し、制約駆動型創造フレームを提示した。
papers.analysis_unit: 中国の新興ナレッジハブのSMEを対象とした質的複数事例研究（事例数の記載なし）
